name: Mori Chatbot
author: mohammadmnd

sections.description:
Welcome to Mori’s Virtual Seller Chatbot, your AI-powered sales assistant for WordPress!
Imagine giving your customers the personalized care of an in-store salesperson—24/7, right on your website. With Mori’s Virtual Seller, you can engage, assist, and convert visitors into buyers with ease.
Key Features
Free to Start: Register for free at mori.style and create your own Virtual Seller in just minutes.

Shopping Expert: Mori’s Virtual Seller is not just a question-answering chatbot – it’s trained to sell. It knows your products, engages customers by answering their queries, and guides them through the purchasing process.

Multi-Lingual and Always-On: Surprise your customers by providing expert advice and support day and night, no matter which language they speak.

Your Virtual Seller, Your Rules: Customize response protocols, conversation tone, and handover scenarios. Your virtual seller adapts to your needs, delivering personalized and efficient service tailored to your business.
Safe: The virtual seller data are all yours and no one has access to them, and you can delete all your user information and chats within one click.

How It Works:

  1. Register at mori.style.
  2. Set up your chatbot by customizing its settings (welcome message, branding, etc.).
  3. Copy your sharing_id from the Mori dashboard.
  4. Paste it into the plugin settings in WordPress, and your Virtual Seller is live!

External Service Dependency

This plugin relies on Mori’s external API to function.
API URL: https://standardapi.dori.tech/
Purpose: To process chatbot interactions and provide personalized responses.

Privacy Policy

Your privacy is important to us. Here’s what you should know:
Data Collection: The chatbot processes user messages to provide relevant responses.
GDPR Compliance: For users in the EU, all data is stored and processed on EU-based servers to comply with GDPR requirements.
User Control: You can delete chat data directly using the “Delete Data” button in your Mori dashboard.

Read our full Privacy Policyfor more details.

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later. See https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-2.0.html for more information.
sections.installation:
Getting started with Mori Virtual Seller is quick and easy:

  1. Download and upload the mori-chatbot folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to the mori Virtual Seller settings page in your WordPress admin dashboard.
  4. Enter your sharing_id (from your Mori dashboard) into the settings.

Your Virtual Seller is now live and ready to assist your visitors!
sections.faq:
How does the chatbot work?

The chatbot connects to the Mori API to handle conversations. It uses AI to understand customer questions and provides responses based on your product catalog and chatbot setup.

What does it cost?

Creating your Virtual Seller is completely free. You can register at Mori.style and set up your chatbot without any cost.

What data is collected?

The chatbot processes user queries entered during conversations. No personal information is stored unless explicitly provided by users in the chat.

Can I use multiple chatbots?

Currently, the plugin supports one chatbot per website.

Does it work with all themes?

Yes! The Mori Virtual Seller is designed to work seamlessly with any WordPress theme.
